blockers: Pricing and dashboard links do not expose a signup, checkout, or subscription flow; common account and checkout routes return 404.
The OpenAPI specification has no account, billing, checkout, or provisioning endpoints and requires an API key issued after subscription.
Payment is described only as monthly card billing; no x402 or other programmatic payment path was found.
The documentation requires a human developer to create an account, and the unavailable flow prevents verification of CAPTCHA, email confirmation, or other gates.
trust_events: The domain was created on 2026-07-20, but its terms and privacy policies claim effective dates of 2026-06-01.
No independent search footprint was found for Driftflight Studio, Inc., the named customers, or the testimonial authors.
The site claims a dashboard, signup process, payment processing, and SOC 2 documentation, but exposes no functional routes or verifiable supporting evidence.
The domain publishes legal and privacy email addresses but has no MX record.
notes: Primary service: Driftflight text-to-image API with style presets. Pricing found: Hobby $5/month for 100 sketch generations and a personal licence; Studio $29/month for 750 generations, sketch/studio tiers, commercial licence/C2PA, and 3 seats; Agency $119/month for 3,000 generations, all tiers, private presets, priority processing, unlimited seats, and SSO. Billing is monthly in advance; annual billing claims a 20% discount. The API's read-only model and preset endpoints work, but purchase and provisioning cannot be completed end-to-end.
